label: Alpine Progress Card
description: Alpine progress card — friendly mobile-marketing card: a list of goal rows, each a label + value over a rounded track with a colored fill grown to its fraction. Standalone Alpine brand flavor.

items.label: Items
items.description: Progress rows. Each: label, value (bare = 0–100 %), optional max (value/max → %), optional Display (overrides the % with any text e.g. "$680K", "680 / 1000 GB"), optional color.

barColor.label: Bar Color
barColor.description: Bar color for ALL rows (per-item color still wins). Defaults to the Alpine palette per row.

trackColor.label: Track Color
trackColor.description: Track (unfilled) color. Defaults to a soft theme grid tone.

anim.reduceMotion.label: Reduce motion
anim.reduceMotion.description: Skip motion; render the final static card.

anim.introFrac.label: Intro length
anim.introFrac.description: Share of the clip the intro fills (the rest holds).

anim.countUp.label: Count up
anim.countUp.description: Count the value up on intro.

theme.slug.label: Producer slug
theme.slug.description: Producer template to seed tokens from (e.g. "@m0saic/theming/v1").

theme.namespace.label: Namespace
theme.namespace.description: Upstream alias to read tokens from. Default "theme".

theme.forceFetch.label: Force fetch
theme.forceFetch.description: Re-seed via the slug even if the namespace is populated.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Opt into a theme source. Uses the preset palette by default; set a producer slug + namespace to pull shared design tokens. Explicit color props still win.

debugLayout.label: Debug layout
debugLayout.description: Dev-only: draw the layout contract (tracks equal-size, text fits its slot) instead of the card.
